findings.title: MessageFormat choice branches are excluded from HTML sanitization
findings.body: For linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit* and error-invalid-multivalued-size, normalizeValue() replaces the entire '{n,choice,...}' segment with '...' before the OWASP sanitizer runs. Any HTML placed inside a choice branch, for example '{0,choice,0#<script>alert(1)</script>|1#second|1<seconds}', is therefore never inspected, while Java MessageFormat will emit the selected branch text at runtime. Only the choice-limit syntax such as '1<' should be neutralized, or each choice branch should be extracted and sanitized, rather than discarding the whole user-controlled segment.

findings.title: Missing English bundle aborts verification with an unchecked exception
findings.body: verifySafeHtml() derives the English file name from the localized file and throws a RuntimeException when that derived file cannot be read. verify() only declares MojoExecutionException and its caller-facing contract is to return collected verification messages, so a locale bundle whose English counterpart is missing or whose name does not match the derivation regex aborts the whole plugin run with a stack trace instead of reporting the offending file and continuing or failing as a MojoExecutionException.

findings.title: Anchor mismatch message does not identify the key or file
findings.body: When santizeAnchors() rejects a translation it adds only 'Didn't find anchor tag ... in original string', without the message key or properties file, unlike the Illegal HTML diagnostic which includes both. The verifier runs over hundreds of message files, so a translator or maintainer seeing this build failure cannot locate the offending entry from the message alone.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat choice syntax breaks Account UI i18next message
findings.body: This bundle is rendered by the Account UI with i18next-style placeholders, as the surrounding error messages use {{0}}, {{1}} and {{2}}. Changing this entry to Java MessageFormat '{0}' plus '{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' means i18next will not substitute the values or evaluate the choice; users will see the literal braces/choice expression instead of a formatted sentence. The Java choice form belongs only in the server-side theme bundle, not in this UI bundle.

findings.title: Java MessageFormat choice syntax breaks Admin UI i18next message
findings.body: As in the Account UI bundle, this Admin UI bundle uses i18next {{0}}-style interpolation for its error messages. Replacing 'Attribute {{0}} ... {{2}} value(s).' with '{0}' and '{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' introduces syntax i18next cannot evaluate, so the message will render literally without the attribute name and bounds substituted. Keep the UI bundle in {{ }} form and apply the choice-format change only to the server-side Java bundle.

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian account bundle now contains 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:', which is Italian for 'Install one of the following applications on your mobile phone'. Lithuanian users will see instructions in the wrong language; the previous Lithuanian sentence should be kept, translated without the removed anchor tags.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 was replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The Lithuanian login bundle now contains the Italian sentence 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' instead of a Lithuanian translation of 'Install one of the following applications on your mobile:'. Lithuanian users will see Italian on the login TOTP setup page; restore a Lithuanian translation without the removed anchor tags.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text inserted into Simplified Chinese bundle
findings.body: totpStep1 now reads '在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：', using Traditional Chinese characters (手機, 應用程式) in the messages_zh_CN bundle whose other entries use Simplified Chinese (手机, 应用程序). Convert it to Simplified Chinese, e.g. '在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：', so zh_CN users do not see a different script.

findings.title: No test that legitimate HTML or matching anchors pass
findings.body:
Every test asserts that an error message is present; none asserts that a clean bundle returns an empty result. Legitimate cases such as noHtml_en itself, a translation whose anchors exactly match the English anchors, allowed

//
markup when the English value contains HTML, numeric <0> placeholders and MessageFormat choice values are untested, so a regression that makes the sanitizer reject all HTML would still pass this suite while breaking valid translations.
